import std.actor as actor

@rust("native::connector")
extern async def connector(signal: actor.TaskReady) -> Result[unit, Error]

@rust("native::connector_starts")
extern def connector_starts() -> i64

@rust("native::connector_active")
extern def connector_active() -> i64

@rust("native::connector_cleanups")
extern def connector_cleanups() -> i64

class Context:
    initial: i64

class WorkerState:
    completed: i64

enum Job:
    Process(units: i64)
    Read
    FailWorker

enum JobError:
    InvalidUnits

class Totals:
    packing: i64
    audit: i64

class Report:
    packing_total: i64
    audit_total: i64
    packing_starts: i64
    audit_starts: i64
    connector_starts: i64
    failed_events: i64
    panicked_events: i64
    restarts: i64
    stopped_children: i64
    shutdown_events: i64
    connector_active: i64
    connector_cleanups: i64

async def create_worker(context: shared[Context]) -> Result[WorkerState, Error]:
    return ok(WorkerState(completed=context.initial))

async def process_job(state: WorkerState, job: Job) -> Result[actor.Turn[WorkerState, i64, JobError], Error]:
    match job:
        case Job.Process(units):
            if units < 1 or units > 100:
                return ok(actor.turn[WorkerState, i64, JobError](state, fail(JobError.InvalidUnits)))
            completed = state.completed + units
            return ok(actor.turn[WorkerState, i64, JobError](WorkerState(completed=completed), ok(completed)))
        case Job.Read:
            completed = state.completed
            return ok(actor.turn[WorkerState, i64, JobError](state, ok(completed)))
        case Job.FailWorker:
            return error("controlled packing worker failure")

async def run_connector(context: shared[Context], signal: actor.TaskReady) -> Result[unit, Error]:
    return await connector(signal)

async def monitor(group: actor.Supervisor[Context]) -> Result[unit, Error]:
    return await actor.run(group)

async def request(worker: view[actor.Actor[Job, i64, JobError]], job: Job) -> Result[i64, Error]:
    match await actor.call(worker, job, 5000, 5000):
        case Ok(reply):
            match reply:
                case Ok(value):
                    return ok(value)
                case Err(_):
                    return error("unexpected job rejection")
        case Err(_):
            return error("worker unavailable")

async def wait_event(control: view[actor.Control], name: view[str], generation: i64, kind: actor.EventKind) -> Result[unit, Error]:
    reached = False
    while not reached:
        match await actor.next_event_timeout(control, 5000):
            case Ok(next):
                match next:
                    case Some(event):
                        if event.child_name == name and event.kind == kind and event.generation == generation:
                            reached = True
                    case None:
                        return error("supervisor stopped before the expected event")
            case Err(problem):
                if problem.kind == actor.WaitKind.TIMEOUT:
                    return error("supervisor event deadline exceeded")
                return error("invalid supervisor event deadline")
    return ok(assert_true(reached))

async def exercise(packing: view[actor.Actor[Job, i64, JobError]], audit: view[actor.Actor[Job, i64, JobError]], control: view[actor.Control], connector_events: view[actor.Control]) -> Result[Totals, Error]:
    match await actor.ready(packing, 5000):
        case Ok(_):
            assert_true(True)
        case Err(_):
            return error("packing worker did not start")
    match await actor.ready(audit, 5000):
        case Ok(_):
            assert_true(True)
        case Err(_):
            return error("audit worker did not start")
    assert_true(try await request(packing, Job.Process(5)) == 5)
    assert_true(try await request(audit, Job.Process(7)) == 7)
    match await actor.call(packing, Job.Process(-1), 5000, 5000):
        case Ok(reply):
            match reply:
                case Ok(_):
                    return error("invalid job was accepted")
                case Err(problem):
                    match problem:
                        case JobError.InvalidUnits:
                            print("job rejected: packing total stays 5")
        case Err(_):
            return error("business error was lost")
    assert_true(try await request(packing, Job.Read) == 5)
    match await actor.call(packing, Job.FailWorker, 5000, 5000):
        case Ok(_):
            return error("worker failure returned a reply")
        case Err(problem):
            assert_true(problem.kind == actor.CallKind.REPLY_LOST)
    assert_true(try await request(audit, Job.Process(2)) == 9)
    packing_name = "packing"
    try await wait_event(control, view(packing_name), 2, actor.EventKind.STARTED)
    assert_true(try await request(packing, Job.Read) == 0)
    print("packing restarted: total reset to 0; audit continued at 9")
    connector_name = "connector"
    try await wait_event(connector_events, view(connector_name), 2, actor.EventKind.READY)
    assert_true(connector_starts() == 2 and connector_active() == 1)
    assert_true(connector_cleanups() == 1)
    packing_total = try await request(packing, Job.Process(4))
    audit_total = try await request(audit, Job.Read)
    assert_true(packing_total == 4 and audit_total == 9)
    print("connector panic recovered: generation 2 is active")
    return ok(Totals(packing=packing_total, audit=audit_total))

async def finish(packing: actor.Actor[Job, i64, JobError], audit: actor.Actor[Job, i64, JobError], control: actor.Control, events: actor.Control, connector_events: actor.Control) -> Result[unit, Error]:
    outcome = await exercise(view(packing), view(audit), view(control), view(connector_events))
    # Keep cleanup explicit even if exercise returns an Error.
    try await actor.shutdown(view(control))
    totals = try outcome
    assert_true(connector_active() == 0)
    assert_true(connector_cleanups() == 2)
    match await actor.call(view(packing), Job.Read, 0, 5000):
        case Ok(_):
            return error("stopped worker accepted a job")
        case Err(problem):
            assert_true(problem.kind == actor.CallKind.STOPPED)
    packing_starts = 0
    audit_starts = 0
    connector_started = 0
    connector_ready = 0
    failed = 0
    panicked = 0
    restarts = 0
    stopped = 0
    shutdown = 0
    reading = True
    while reading:
        match try await actor.next_event(view(events)):
            case Some(event):
                if event.kind == actor.EventKind.STARTED:
                    if event.child_name == "packing":
                        packing_starts = packing_starts + 1
                    if event.child_name == "audit":
                        audit_starts = audit_starts + 1
                    if event.child_name == "connector":
                        connector_started = connector_started + 1
                if event.kind == actor.EventKind.READY:
                    assert_true(event.child_name == "connector" and event.generation == 2)
                    connector_ready = connector_ready + 1
                if event.kind == actor.EventKind.FAILED:
                    failed = failed + 1
                if event.kind == actor.EventKind.PANICKED:
                    panicked = panicked + 1
                if event.kind == actor.EventKind.RESTART_SCHEDULED:
                    restarts = restarts + 1
                if event.kind == actor.EventKind.STOPPED:
                    stopped = stopped + 1
                if event.kind == actor.EventKind.SHUTDOWN:
                    shutdown = shutdown + 1
                assert_true(event.kind != actor.EventKind.LAGGED)
                assert_true(event.kind != actor.EventKind.INTENSITY_EXCEEDED)
            case None:
                reading = False
    assert_true(packing_starts == 2 and audit_starts == 1)
    assert_true(connector_started == 2 and connector_starts() == 2 and connector_ready == 1)
    assert_true(failed == 1 and panicked == 1 and restarts == 2)
    assert_true(stopped == 3 and shutdown == 1)
    report = Report(packing_total=totals.packing, audit_total=totals.audit, packing_starts=packing_starts, audit_starts=audit_starts, connector_starts=connector_started, failed_events=failed, panicked_events=panicked, restarts=restarts, stopped_children=stopped, shutdown_events=shutdown, connector_active=connector_active(), connector_cleanups=connector_cleanups())
    encoded = try json_encode(report)
    return ok(print(encoded))

async def main() -> Result[unit, Error]:
    group = actor.supervisor[Context](Context(initial=0), actor.default_options())
    packing = try actor.register[WorkerState, Job, i64, JobError](view(group), "packing", create_worker, process_job, actor.default_actor_options())
    audit = try actor.register[WorkerState, Job, i64, JobError](view(group), "audit", create_worker, process_job, actor.default_actor_options())
    try actor.task_with_ready(view(group), "connector", run_connector, actor.RestartPolicy.TRANSIENT)
    control = actor.control(view(group))
    events = actor.clone_control(view(control))
    connector_events = actor.clone_control(view(control))
    async with scope:
        spawn monitor(group)
        spawn finish(packing, audit, control, events, connector_events)
    return ok(assert_true(True))
